classification_basis: All 36 items (EFF-0001 to EFF-0036) were previously classified as answer_new_effect_candidate. Mathematical classification criteria applied: each describes a stable observable phenomenon under specific conditions (C => delta Y != 0), answers 'what stable phenomenon occurred', is not the mechanism itself, and can be explained by functions. All 36 meet effect criteria.
recommendation: All 36 are classified as effect candidates with medium confidence. They require dual-channel bootstrap verification before becoming active effects. Migration to data/effects/ is proposed but not executed in this classification-only phase.
